title: Live_From_The_VPS_8e8d44b3
style: Pop rock with a corporate tech aesthetic. Clean electric guitar plays palm-muted eighth-note patterns in the verses, transitioning to open power chords in the choruses. A synth bass follows the root notes of the guitar progression. The drum kit features a tight, dry snare and a consistent kick pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, almost spoken-word style during the verses, shifting to a melodic, layered harmony in the choruses. A bright, sawtooth synth lead doubles the vocal melody in the chorus. The track is in the key of E Major at 128 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean palm-muted electric guitar, synth bass, tight drum kit]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic male vocals]
1-4-9-1-9-4-8
1-6-6
1-0-9
That's the address, that's the line
1-1-9 gigabytes of RAM
That's the brain, that's the plan
Giggy-gigabytes of disk
Everything on it, that's the risk
7-8-1 percent use getting close
But the stack is running, that's what counts most

[Chorus]
[layered vocal harmonies, bright synth lead, open electric guitar chords]
Live from the VPS, we are here
Live from the VPS, what a fear
Cloudflare in front, B1 behind
Live from the VPS, one of a kind
We've been running at 1-7-9-9
Live from the VPS
Everything's fine

[Verse 2]
[palm-muted guitar returns]
Worker deployed, Corey, I-F-P
Every endpoint live, no delay
B1 tables all confirmed
Every schema already learned
Zinval index, F-P-7 files
Journal append only miles and miles
Every session state saved here
Live from the VPS, year by year
[drums and guitar drop to low volume]
It's not Silicon Valley
It's a 15-month server in a data center
And it's running everything
That's the story

[Chorus]
[full instrumentation returns]
Live from the VPS, we are here
Live from the VPS, what a fear
Cloudflare in front, B1 behind
Live from the VPS, one of a kind
We've been running at 1-7-9-9
Live from the VPS
Everything's fine

[Outro]
Live from the VPS, still running
Corey, James McIver, Cindy-O!
